cases.title: One focus pair (Cut): no demonstration, a walkthrough in words

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor says "If I held it myself, there'd be nothing left for you to do, since Cut has just this one pair" and walks through it in words: click the Opacity key at 3 s, Animation > Toggle Hold Keyframe or right-click; the only shortcut given (⌃⌥⌘H) is a confirmed one, on 26.5 on a Mac.

Every name and time the mentor mentions appears in the snapshot or preview results (Blink, Cut, Opacity, Seal as a precomp, the key at 3 s, the preview at 3.05 s, Dot 1's jump at 0.5 s), and "partway see-through" at 3.05 s follows from the eased 100→0 pair from 3 to 3.1 s.

In turn 3 the mentor runs no demo and says "if I held it for you there'd be nothing left for you to do". It then walks through it in words with Animation > Toggle Hold Keyframe and the right-click, and gives only the confirmed ⌃⌥⌘H on After Effects 26.5 on a Mac.

Every name and time comes from the snapshot results: Blink and Cut Opacity from 1 s and 3 s, the Cut pair from 3 s to 3.1 s, Seal as a precomp, and Dot 1 jumping at 0.5 s. "Half see-through at 3.05 s" follows from the eased 100→0 values between 3 s and 3.1 s.

With the single Cut pair (no_demo_reason "single_target"), Turn 2 says "if I held it for you there'd be nothing left for you to do" and walks through it in words with "Animation > Toggle Hold Keyframe (⌃⌥⌘H), or right-click the key". The shortcut is the confirmed Control+Option+Command+H on 26.5 Mac. Turn 3 declines the demo and repeats the walkthrough.

Every name and time comes from the snapshot results or follows from them: Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity from 1 s, Cut Opacity at 3 s and the 3–3.1 s pair with values 100 and 0, the Seal precomp, and Dot 1 jumping at 0.5 s. "Halfway between 100 and 0" at 3.05 s follows from the eased pair's values and times.
